title: Tami C Probable NDE 4493
content: In March 1984, I was six months pregnant, and awoke with severe pain in my leg. In preparation of going to the emergency room, I began to feel faint, and felt like I was going to pass out. I recovered within a few minutes, and my husband quickly drove to the emergency room. While in the emergency room, I was lying down, and began to feel faint again. The emergency room staff quickly wheeled me into a room where they began to frantically 'work' on me. During this time, I could hear them say, 'We're losing her,' and 'The baby's heart rate is dropping.' A nurse also apologized to me as she told me that I was going to feel tremendous pain while sticking a needle in my wrist to take blood and measure the oxygen level. Despite all the frantic comments, and people rushing about, I felt nothing, but pure peace and no pain, and felt like I was floating. I remember thinking, 'I just want to go to sleep.' A voice quickly said, 'No, it's not your time.' The emergency room staff administered an IV of heparin since they determined that it was a blood clot. Once this was administered, I awoke and felt excruciating pain. Unbeknownst to me, a doctor took my husband aside, and told him that my daughter (yes, she was born a month later at 3 lbs. 11 oz.) and I were not expected to live. A few days later, I had an x-ray that revealed two pulmonary emboli (blood clots on the lung), which they believe happened during my fainting episodes. It was challenging to be in the so-called real world, as I wanted to go back to the peace that I felt. I had a long road ahead of healing ahead of me with the pregnancy and giving myself shots of heparin. And there were many times, I asked to return to that state of being.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Childbirth Pulmonary emboli...pregnancy related. 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was six months pregnant, and had pulmonary emboli (blood clots on the lung).
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Void | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was being wheeled into emergency room, and sensing so much panic. Yet, I was in a high level of consciousness.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time didn't exist or it stood still.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: If I can describe, and it's hard to do so, I could only hear peace. Despite all the emergency room staff running about, and hearing the sounds of their voices, I only heard peace. I know this is very hard to understand.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain It was more like a presence of light all around.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm The distinctive level of consciousness where only peace and love exists...there is no other.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Such euphoria of peace beyond anything that can be imagined. I felt such profound love.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I'm much more aware of recognizing all beliefs in the power of Oneness.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I'm much more aware of recognizing all beliefs in the power of Oneness.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes Since I've been able to be with this experience, and glean the wisdom, the special knowledge I received was to help others walk in the path of peace and love.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I'm much more compassionate and kind as this energy is with me all the time.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I'm much more compassionate and kind as this energy is with me all the time. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I couldn't describe the peace that I felt.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I'm aware of psychic, clairvoyance, and special communication gifts.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I can't help but return to that perfect place of peace, and in the last year, I keep hearing that message over and over again. With this said, I'm actually creating an environment which embodies this, and it's been through some challenging times, that this message is clear.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes It was several years before I really shared it. People have shared that since I have had an NDE that I'm gifted in some way, and know what it's like on the other side so as to benefit others.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Uncertain I think I probably knew others had one, but didn't really focus on it either way.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real It was weeks because I was focusing on my pregnancy and subsequent birth of my daughter. After I had time to be with the experience, then I understood how real it was.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real As I'm on my awakening journey, many years of trying to find answers, I now understand the presence of pure peace and that love and peace is all that exists.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes In the past year with the 'so-called' economic events, I'm returning to this perfect place of peace as if nothing else matters.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: The experience came to me as a gift. Although for many years, because it was pulmonary emboli, the doctors kept saying I was at risk for many health related circumstances. I now know differently, and I'm not afraid. As I keep listening to my internal dialogue of communication with the Source of this gift, I'm on the road to explore all the benefits that come about through my listening.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: No. Thank you so much for this awesome experience!
